segments.name: Real estate finance
products: residential mortgage loans in securitization trusts
segments.description: Acquires, invests in and finances mortgage-related assets, chiefly newly-originated non-QM loans, aiming for risk-adjusted returns for stockholders.
segments.evidence: The Company has determined it currently operates in a single operating segment and has one reportable segment, which is to acquire, invest in, and finance mortgage‑related assets.

revenueModel.text: The Company earns interest income on the residential and commercial mortgage loans it holds, paid by borrowers.
revenueModel.evidence: Interest income on residential mortgage loans and commercial mortgage loans is recognized using the effective interest method over the life of the loans.
